userStories.title: Rename verb + function (no alias)
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis review` is the new public verb; `praxis week` is removed entirely (no deprecation alias, per Section 3).
praxis/cli/__main__.py renames cmd_week to cmd_review; internal names run_weekly and WeeklyRunSummary are unchanged per Section 3.
Invoking `praxis week` produces argparse's standard 'unknown command' error and exits non-zero; existing scripts that ran `praxis week` will fail loudly rather than silently.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Commitment + reflection rollup in run_weekly
acceptanceCriteria: run_weekly produces a CommitmentRollup carrying display_text, sessions count vs prior week, self_report tallies (yes/no/partial/skip aggregated from session_reflections.follow_up_id), and per-dimension before/after rates computed from session_scores within the week.
WeeklyRunSummary (or the report adapter wrapping it) exposes the CommitmentRollup; both renderers receive it via praxis/reports/adapter.py.
When no commitment exists for the rendered week, CommitmentRollup is None and renderers gracefully omit the masthead's commitment block rather than crashing.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Terminal masthead with commitment block
acceptanceCriteria: praxis/reports/digest_terminal.py renders the masthead from Section 2 verbatim: focus quote, sessions counts, self-report tally, the data-says line for the targeted dimension, and the gap-summary line.

When self-report and the dimension data agree, the gap-summary reads 'your self-report and the data agree this week.'; when they disagree, it renders the gap-detection prose produced by the constrained judge under US-037.
If a renderer receives CommitmentRollup with sessions=0, it prints 'No sessions logged this week.' instead of a divide-by-zero or empty numeric line.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: HTML masthead + interactive prompt gating
acceptanceCriteria: praxis/reports/digest_html.py renders the same masthead content as the terminal version inside the existing HTML report shell, mirroring the field labels and ordering.

After printing the terminal masthead, the command renders the [k]eep / [n]ew / [d]igest prompt only when sys.stdin.isatty() AND `--non-interactive` was not passed; on [k]eep it inserts a new follow_ups row for next week with the same display_text, on [n]ew it dispatches to cmd_commit inline, on [d]igest it returns 0.

Invocation with `--notify --non-interactive` (the install-weekly LaunchAgent path) renders the masthead and exits 0 without ever printing the prompt; an automated test asserts no prompt text appears in captured stdout for that flag combination.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Gap-detection prose under constrained judge prompt
acceptanceCriteria: A new helper in praxis/reports/ (or a small judge module) generates the gap-summary closing paragraph via the cheap-tier judge when self_report and dim data disagree by >=1 standard deviation (or a documented threshold), under a system prompt that forbids accusatory framing and asks for curiosity-only phrasing.
The judge output is bounded at <=2 sentences; the renderer truncates anything longer with an ellipsis-and-period rather than emitting an unbounded blob.

When the judge call fails or no API key is present, the renderer falls back to a static, neutral phrasing ('Self-report and data differ this week. Worth a moment of curiosity.') rather than erroring or omitting the line.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest
